topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I walk down the old path, my heart heavy with memories. The path where I used to skip, laughing, feeling the warmth of the sun on my face. There, at the end, stood the tree I planted as a child, a sapling back then, now it was supposed to touch the sky. I approach, but something is off. The ground is disturbed, a fresh scar in the earth. Where the tree once stood, there's only silence. My hands tremble as I touch the rough stump, questioning the world that could let this happen.
